recipe.visualDefinition: A warm, sepia-toned portrait of a woman reclining on a dark leather sofa, wearing a thick ribbed knit sweater. The composition is intimate and low-key, with typography centered at the top against a dark background.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochromatic sepia palette creates a nostalgic, warm mood
Texture contrast between the ribbed knit sweater and smooth leather
Top-heavy typographic alignment balancing the subject's diagonal pose
Soft directional lighting highlighting facial features and sweater texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, angled diagonally from bottom left to middle right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large-scale display text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large text, move down to the subject's face, then follow the texture of the sweater across the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, shadowed areas of the leather sofa provide negative space for the text to pop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep umber and chocolate browns in the shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm cream and tan in the highlights of the sweater.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white for the primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value contrast between highlights and deep shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Large geometric uppercase paired with smaller, tighter sentence-case sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Thin white border framing the entire image

preserve: Wide tracking of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, clean uppercase look of the primary title.
Provides a similar humanist feel for the secondary subtitle text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-contrast, sepia-toned photograph of a woman with short hair reclining on a dark leather sofa, wearing a thick cream-colored ribbed knit sweater. The lighting should be warm and moody, with deep shadows in the background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered white text at the top. The first line should be a large, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif in all caps. The second line should be a smaller, sentence-case sans-serif directly underneath. Add a thin white border around the entire composition.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly sepia/monochromatic?
Is the main title text in all caps with wide spacing?
Is the subject wearing a textured knit sweater?
Is there a thin white border around the image edge?

adjustableVariables: Tracking width of the display text
Contrast level of the leather texture
mustRedesign: Avoid any modern digital filters that look artificial; stick to classic film-style sepia.
Ensure the text does not overlap the subject's face.
postGenerationChecks: Check for uniform sepia tone across the image.
Ensure the white text is legible against the dark background.
Verify the diagonal composition of the subject.
Confirm the presence of the thin white outer frame.
recipe.reuseFormula: Sepia Portrait + Ribbed Texture + Geometric Sans Overlay + Wide Tracking + White Border
